_note: Maintained data that the Blizzard API does not provide for WoW Forever: per instance (name as in the achievement criteria, or the raid name) the level range [min, max] under levels and the boss names in German under bosses, as in the statistic "Siege über BOSS (INSTANZ)". For dungeons the LAST entry is always the final boss: only it appears in the Blizzard statistics and indicates completion (confirmed on 2026-11-06 across all members: Bazzalan, Rath'mael, Durgen Dirgehammer, Edwin van Cleef). The statistic inflects names ("Siege über Mutanus den Verschlinger"); "den" counts as "der" when comparing. "statisticEntries" (optional) lists entries under which the statistic records the final boss with a different instance or boss name, each {instance, finalBoss} as in "Siege über ENDBOSS (INSTANZ)"; they also indicate completion. "withoutStatistic": true marks dungeons whose final boss does not appear in the statistic at all (checked on 2026-11-27 across all members: no entry, although many have the criterion). For them there is no proof per character: the character page only shows "auf diesem Account" from the account-wide achievements, and the guild overview neither counts them nor names them as a guild goal. Sources: mmonster.co/de/wow-forever (levels, boss lists), wowhead.com/de (spelling), conquestcapped.com. "_check" names uncertainties from the research of 2026-11-06.
